== Trivia ==
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on August 17, 2022.
** The 35th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on January 28, 2024.
** The 20th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on February 23, 2025.
** The 14th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2500 kills in the LPL on September 10, 2025.
** The 11th player to reach 2500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on February 23, 2025
** The 30th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on August 27, 2025.
** The 22nd player to reach 600 games in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on September 01, 2025.
** Was the 26th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on September 13, 2025.
** Was the 43rd player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
